## XpmLiquidActions.\_isInitialised property

Flag indicating whether the actions collection has been initialised.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected _isInitialised: boolean;
```

## Remarks

This flag prevents redundant initialisation and ensures idempotent behavior when [XpmLiquidActions.initialise()](./xpm-lib.xpmliquidactions.initialise.md) is called multiple times.

State transitions:

<ol> <li>Initially <code>false</code> after construction.</li> <li>Set to <code>true</code> after successful template expansion and action name registration.</li> <li>Checked at the beginning of <code>XpmLiquidActions.initialise</code> to return early if already initialised.</li> </ol>

This pattern supports safe repeated calls during complex initialisation sequences without duplicating work or corrupting internal state.
